resources.string: Letters you\'ve sent stay as they are
Letters you\'ve already sent stay open with no time limit.\nWhat changes is the new letters you send from now on.
Choose how to send each new letter
A permanent letter uses 1 letter pass and has no time limit.\nA %1$d-day letter is free to send.
A %1$d-day letter stays open for %1$d days
That\'s %1$d days from the day the recipient first opens it.\n%2$d days after it closes, the letter and its photos are deleted.
You can keep a closed letter too
Until it\'s deleted, 1 letter pass opens it again.\nBoth the sender and the recipient can do this.
Letter passes, right when you need one
If you don\'t have a letter pass, you can buy one on the spot.\nYou can see your letter passes in your profile.
